rules.hash: SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes, lowercase hex, prefixed 'sha256:' in fingerprints; the file hash is bare hex.
rules.itemFingerprint: sha256 of canonicalJson(item without sourceFingerprint). canonicalJson = keys sorted by UTF-16 code unit at every level, arrays in given order, no whitespace, JSON string escaping.
rules.manifestFingerprint: sha256 of canonicalJson({schemaVersion, siteId, items:[{id, sourceFingerprint}...]}) with items in manifest order.
rules.onDiskForm: UTF-8, no BOM, LF, 2-space indent (JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) layout), keys sorted, exactly one trailing newline.
rules.strings: NFC-normalized, no CR, no forbidden characters (see characterPolicy); description may contain LF and TAB.
rules.ordering: content: tools first by id (UTF-16 code-unit order), then articles by numeric id. relatedContentIds and capabilities are unique and sorted (tools first, articles numerically).
rules.categoryless: A tool with category null is valid only when its section is listed in the consumer's trusted local configuration (categorylessSections); the vectors under categorylessTool need categorylessSections to include 'sample-direct'. With the default empty configuration such a manifest is rejected.
